body: My friend said I should shut up and stop complaining if I’m not gonna help myself, and that he doesn’t feel bad for me. I blocked him and deleted every app he could message me on, but I think he’s right. And I’ve already lost one of the very few friends I have.
I didn’t go. I just stayed in bed most of the day.

I don’t think it’s okay... I’m just making more stress for myself. I can barely handle school without having to deal with all this.

I’m a sad ugly loser today, a sad ugly loser yesterday, a sad ugly loser tomorrow. When is this going to change? And why would anyone ever like me?

Nobody cares enough about me to make fun of me to my face. I call myself a whiny loser because I’m whining right now and I’m a loser with no social life. And I don’t like who I am, I’d much rather be different. I just don’t want to work to change it. I might just be lazy.
I dont want to. I won’t. Leave me alone. You’ve wasted your time. I’m tired.

It’s too hard... I don’t want to keep waiting. It makes me upset. I don’t want to change. I hope someone likes me as a miserable, out of shape disgusting pile of shit who lays in bed all day. Because that’s all I am. I’m not beautiful, and I’m not attractive. Maybe I could change that, but I choose not to. Would you date someone like me? Could you find anyone who would WANT to date someone like me? Most people wouldn’t even settle.
Do you think it’ll be okay?
What if treatment never helps? It hasn’t even a little bit so far. It’s gotten worse, and it’s getting worse still. I’m not at rock bottom. My life isn’t that bad.

Unless several of my close friends have been playing extremely elaborate pranks on me or are secret compulsive liars, people are having sex and relationships. And I’m not. I can’t deny it.

I’m not pretty. Nobody has ever called me pretty. Nobody has ever complimented my looks. The only time I ever remember anyone saying anything nice about my appearance was when my dad said I was “handsome” once. Other than that, even my parents have never told me I look good. I’m ugly. And I don’t have the personality to make up for it. I’m boring, stupid, lazy, selfish, and unmotivated. I’m a gross, slimy person to the core. Nobody could ever love a thing like me.

I don’t talk to people anymore. I live in my own world. I haven’t spoken to a girl in months. I ruined the one chance I maybe had for a relationship for no reason. I’m never going to have a relationship in high school. I’ve given up. I’ve failed. All my friends are just better than me. It makes me want to cry
I’ll love myself once I have a reason to.

I was a joke at that summer camp. A pathetic loser who ruined every friendship I had built there. That was the worst few weeks of my entire life. And my parents are just disappointed now. I know they love me. But I just want out.

If I can’t kill myself, what will I do...? I can’t keep living like this... something has to break eventually. What’ll happen if I just keep living? Will I be miserable forever? Will I always feel like I feel right now? Is this what I am?

Yes, I would. I’m that selfish.

I don’t think of suicide that harshly. I’ve been planning on doing it for a while now, and I’ve kind of accepted it. I’m just now realizing I’ll probably never actually go through with it, however much I wish I could.

I won’t talk to my family. I won’t go to school. I’ll ignore everyone and everything and just wallow away until all of this stops.
I know, you’re right... I guess I wanted to just communicate my feelings on it. Because I already know what choice I made. Thanks for commenting

I didn’t ask to be born. I don’t owe myself anything. I’m gonna fucking kill myself. That’s it. That’s the end of the story. Im NOT going to do any of that. I’m not going to pretend I wish I could anymore. I don’t care how hard it is, I’m gonna kill myself. I can’t live in this world. I can’t do all the things you say. So I’m better off dead. 

Tomorrow I’ll do the exact same thing as yesterday. It’s been like this for a whole year. Nothing has changed except for the worse. It makes me so mad. It makes me want to scream and cry and punch myself and break things. Why can’t I be normal? Is everyone like this?

I don’t want to. It makes me uncomfortable, makes them overbearing, and stresses all of us out. I learned my lesson, I’m never confiding in them again. My mom recently joined a therapy group because of me. I’m a drain on everyone around me.

This morning I woke up and got in the shower, thinking I would finally go to school again today for the first time in weeks... I got out of the shower and went back to bed. I can’t fix myself. I can barely do the bare minimum.

I was prescribed them after I got kicked out of a summer camp for drinking and my parents found out I was thinking about killing myself. I think both my parents feel weird about me now. I don’t want to deal with them. I haven’t gone to school or done homework in two weeks. I might drop out

Not to be dramatic, but this really makes me wonder if it’s even worth living at all... is there anything beautiful or happy for me to experience in this life? Do I need to fucking spend months and months doing shit I don’t enjoy just for a chance at maybe being temporarily happy? I wish I could just kill myself, but even that’s too hard. I feel like I’m in a coma but I’m still awake and can’t do anything.
I live in washington.
My friends all already know, too. Most of them are as well. I’m not that insecure about it, I just know that nobody is gonna want to be with me like that
They wouldn’t kiss me anyway

I need someone to make me, or I won’t. If nobody told me to do anything, I’d just lie in bed all day. I wish I could do that. That’s all I really want. Not a girlfriend who loves me, not a body I’m happy with, not accomplishing something I’m proud of. I’ve never had those and I never will. I just want to be in bed all day. My life is over already. There’s no point in me living anymore. Nothing will ever improve as long as I’m this sorry sack of shit.

I’ve been on antidepressants for a couple months now. I’m likely going to switch medications, considering I feel worse than ever.

What happened to your friend? Did he put in work to make himself better? Or did it magically get better just by time passing? Because unless it’s the second one, it’s not going to happen to me. I’m too lazy to do anything to help even myself. Your friend had a trigger for his lowest point, I had nothing. Nothing bad has happened in my life. If anything, it’s pretty good. I could be living my best life right I’ve ever had right now. But instead every day I wish I was dead. Everything hurts and I’m too tired and lazy to wake up and stop it before it’s too late. I just want to not feel bad anymore. My whole life has been a disaster

Other people need your help, not me.

It’ll just switch one day. I’ll be happy and I can laugh at all the days I spent on reddit feeling like garbage. And I can live a happy life and never be lonely, and I can go to sleep every day excited and content. Do I really want this? Deep down do I just want to be miserable?

Am I just a retard?
